protocol.name: BokehMe defocus convention recovery on fixed public-proxy development scenes
protocol.geometry: PNG8 disparity / 255; focus from filename, checked against metadata; manifest K unchanged
protocol.normalized: lo=min(d); span=max(d)-lo; S=K*((d-lo)/span-(df-lo)/span), per frame; no focus clamp
protocol.pipeline_input: defocus = S / 10; official pipeline multiplies by defocus_scale for the classical renderer
protocol.output: official pipeline clamp [0,1], round to PNG8; independent frames, no temporal filtering

sources.gamma: BokehMe CVPR 2022 paper, quantitative evaluation: circular aperture and gamma 2.2

protocol.selection: Compare both predeclared candidates with the paper BokehMe metric profile, not highest scores on current GT. Freeze only if overall evidence consistently favors one. If mixed, leave unresolved; no post-hoc weighted loss or expanded sweep.
limits: Author BLB instructions explicitly skip normalization for physical disparity; normalized candidate derives from demo, not a published Any-to-Bokeh evaluation adapter.
Keeping K unchanged after normalization changes physical blur by 1/span; this is not a coordinate-only transform.
Replaced scenes and proxy GT cannot uniquely identify the unpublished author adapter.
This is reproduction development, not held-out benchmark validation; freezing before Ours does not remove selection bias.
RM with 24 transitions and author-public 2-transition behavior are separately labeled.
No paper by-K values are available; by-K is diagnostic, not a paper-match threshold.
CuPy scatter uses floating atomicAdd; repeated outputs can differ at floating rounding level. No claim of bitwise CUDA reproducibility.

fvd.preprocessing: cdfvd video preprocess: short side 256 + center crop; byte conversion; public VideoMAE resize 224; [0,1]
fvd.adaptation: n_fake='full' prevents default 2048 repeated samples; PNG decoding replaces video decoding
fvd.temporal_note: public tubelet_size=2: 25 input frames yield 12 temporal tokens; final unmatched frame is unused
fvd.covariance: public FeatureStats population covariance / scipy sqrtm

protocol.scope: public metric kernels with documented PNG/count/scene-boundary adapters; not exact paper replication

vfid.preprocessing: public RGB ImageSequenceDataset: ToTensor, Resize 224x224, then [-1,1]
vfid.adaptation: per-scene datasets avoid public flattened-folder cross-scene clips and broken VideoDataset indices
vfid.covariance: public calculate_fid / numpy.cov ddof=1 / scipy sqrtm

selection.reason: Smaller absolute deviation from the paper BokehMe row in all six predeclared metrics; no weighted score or expanded parameter search. A is better against current GT but is not the reproduction-profile choice.
selection.scope: Reproduction development adapter only; not evidence of exact author configuration or held-out fairness.

demo_equivalence.note: Full unmodified demo via runpy, comparing returned float RGB before JPEG. Native K rescaled only to express A in normalized coordinates.

observations: No obvious focus inversion, missing frame, or frame-order mismatch in reviewed keyframes.
Normalized candidate increases blur; visible in repro_000, repro_003, repro_008.
Repro_001 has occlusion-edge differences against GT. Existing rectangular source boundaries remain part of fixed input.
Sparse keyframe review does not prove all-transition temporal stability; full FD/RM evaluation follows.
10 frames have mapped focus slightly >1 (maximum 1.00183491), from continuous focus versus PNG8 disparity quantization. Preserved without clamp as declared; no changed dataset control.

full_geometry_diagnostics.handling: No focus clamp. Small overshoots from continuous focus versus PNG8 disparity quantization are preserved as predeclared.

qualitative_review.selection_of_additional_scenes: Post-evaluation diagnostic: minimum PSNR, maximum FD, maximum RM (same scene IDs for both candidates)
observations: No obvious missing/reordered frame or focus-object inversion in inspected keyframes.
repro_068: zebra stripes and bright mixed blur differ from GT; normalized candidate increases blur.
repro_012: dark scene with strongly blurred bear/dog and moving sharp subject; FD outlier retained, not uniquely attributed to temporal failure.
repro_193: strong blur and changing occlusion around moving subject; RM outlier retained.
Sparse keyframes do not constitute human review of every transition.
